The best candidate was r = a·exp(−b·t) + c·A·exp(−d·t) + e·A² + f·A²·exp(−g·t) + h·t², which I used as a flexible surrogate. A reaction-order-plus-equilibrium law or a time-dependent catalyst-decay law would be the next thing to test, but I ran out of tool calls before testing them.
